node.title: Re^3: Killing a child process
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Ah, I see. I like offloading things like this to modules, in this case I think [mod://IPC::Run] would be appropriate, the following works for me. If you think the child might misbehave and not terminate on SIGINT, see the [mod://IPC::Run] doc section "Timeouts and Timers" on how to time out the kill operation.

use IPC::Run qw/start/; my $h = start ['play','-q','/home/myname/soundfile.wav']; sleep 5; $h->signal('INT'); $h->finish;
